summary: Build VoC and NPS skills to design surveys, analyze feedback, and drive action. Enrol in TrainingCred's 5-day advanced course.
lede: Voice of the Customer and NPS programmes organize customer feedback into measurable insights and follow-up actions. For professionals who work with customer feedback, service metrics or experience reporting, the training covers survey design and channel planning, NPS segmentation and driver analysis, and coding open-text comments. Participants also practice interpreting dashboards, assigning root-cause actions and creating close-the-loop workflows and stakeholder reports.
audienceIntro: This advanced Voice of the Customer and NPS Programmes course is designed for professionals who already work with customer feedback, service metrics, or experience reporting and need to sharpen their programme design, analysis, and governance capability.
prerequisites: Participants should have working experience with customer feedback, service delivery, customer experience, operations, or quality improvement. Prior use of survey tools, Excel, or dashboard reporting is helpful, but no coding is required. Familiarity with customer journey thinking, complaint handling, or experience measurement will make the exercises easier to apply. This is an advanced course, so you should be ready to work with VoC datasets, NPS tracker templates, segment-level reporting, and close-the-loop workflows. A laptop is required for the practical exercises, and you should be prepared to review sample feedback extracts, dashboards, and action logs during the workshop.
